title: Venues – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Venues
hero.lead: Club and platform administrators maintain locations that can be selected for matches and calendar events in the venue administration area.

body:
Use the overview

The number beside Venues is the total record count. The search field filters by name, address or town. The table is sorted alphabetically by name and shows the name, address, town, latitude and longitude.

  • New venue opens an empty form.
  • The pencil under Actions opens the saved details for editing when you are allowed to edit that record.
  • The bin appears when you have permission to delete the record. Before deletion, a confirmation prompt names the affected venue.

Create a venue

  1. Select New venue.
  2. Enter the name. This is the only field marked as required.
  3. Add the address and town. These details also support the coordinate search.
  4. If required, enter the capacity as a number of zero or more and add a short description under Facilities.
  5. Enter latitude and longitude directly or select Get coordinates from OpenStreetMap. Kaderblick searches using the name, address and town. If exactly one result is found, its coordinates are inserted. If several results are found, select the correct address from the result list.
  6. Enable Floodlights if the venue has them.
  7. Select an available option under Surface, or leave the field empty.
  8. Select Create. Cancel closes the form without saving.

Edit a venue

Select the pencil beside the record. The form contains the same fields as the creation form and is filled with the saved data. Save applies the changes; Cancel discards them.

Roles and permissions

  • Club administrator: in the verified demo, sees venue administration in the administration menu and can create a venue.
  • Super administrator: also has access to this administration area.
  • Edit and delete: Kaderblick evaluates these permissions separately for each record. An action icon only appears when that action is allowed for the record.

Connections to other areas

  • In the calendar, an existing venue can be assigned to an event. A new venue can also be created from the location search while creating an event.
  • Under Matches, the venue appears as the match location. Saved coordinates enable the map or navigation link at that location.
  • A meeting point can be selected or entered independently of the venue.
